import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load()
w=torch.tensor(np.load('contrast_c1_blocks.2.fc1_k12.npy')); b=-0.3419
rng=np.random.default_rng(1); N=8192
xi=rng.standard_normal((N,2)).astype(np.float32); c=rng.random(N).astype(np.float32)
a0=np.asarray(model.decode(net,xi,c)[0] if isinstance(model.decode(net,xi[:2],c[:2]),tuple) else model.decode(net,xi,c))
st={'k':0,'m':None}
cfg={'lo':10,'hi':16,'vx':0.0,'vy':0.0}
def h1(mod,inp,out):
    st['m']=((out@w+b)>0)&(cfg['lo']<=st['k']<cfg['hi'])
def h2(mod,inp,out):
    o=out.clone(); m=st['m']
    o[m,0]+=cfg['vx']; o[m,1]+=cfg['vy']; st['k']+=1; return o
net.blocks[2].fc1.register_forward_hook(h1); net.out.register_forward_hook(h2)
def run():
    st['k']=0; r=model.decode(net,xi,c); return np.asarray(r[0] if isinstance(r,tuple) else r)
cfg['vx']=0; base=run(); print('base same', np.abs(base-a0).max())
bad=lambda a:(a[:,0]<-2.85)&(np.abs(a[:,1])<1.2)
print('bad base', bad(base).mean(), np.histogram(c[bad(base)],bins=10,range=(0,1))[0])
for lo,hi,vx in [(10,16,-4),(10,16,-8),(12,15,-6),(12,15,-10),(8,16,-5)]:
    cfg.update(lo=lo,hi=hi,vx=vx); a=run()
    mv=np.linalg.norm(a-base,axis=1)>0.05
    print(lo,hi,vx,'bad',bad(a).mean().round(4),'moved',mv.mean().round(4),'moved&wasbad',(mv&bad(base)).mean().round(4),'moved mean end',a[mv].mean(0).round(2), 'r', np.linalg.norm(a[mv],axis=1).mean().round(2), 'base r all', np.linalg.norm(base[~bad(base)],axis=1).mean().round(2))

import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load()
w=torch.tensor(np.load('contrast_c1_blocks.2.fc1_k12.npy')); b=-0.1595
rng=np.random.default_rng(2); N=8192
xi=rng.standard_normal((N,2)).astype(np.float32); c=rng.random(N).astype(np.float32)
st={'k':0,'m':None,'any':torch.zeros(N,dtype=torch.bool)}
cfg={'lo':0,'hi':16,'vx':0.0,'vy':0.0}
def h1(mod,inp,out):
    f=((out@w+b)>0); st['m']=f&(cfg['lo']<=st['k']<cfg['hi']); st['any']|=st['m']
def h2(mod,inp,out):
    o=out.clone(); m=st['m']
    o[m,0]+=cfg['vx']; o[m,1]+=cfg['vy']; st['k']+=1; return o
net.blocks[2].fc1.register_forward_hook(h1); net.out.register_forward_hook(h2)
def run():
    st['k']=0; st['any'][:]=False; r=model.decode(net,xi,c); return np.asarray(r[0] if isinstance(r,tuple) else r)
base=run(); f=st['any'].numpy().copy()
print('fired any', f.mean(), np.histogram(c[f],bins=10,range=(0,1))[0], 'end mean', base[f].mean(0), 'n', f.sum())
for lo,hi,vx,vy in [(0,16,-3,0.5),(6,16,-4,0.7),(10,16,-6,1)]:
    cfg.update(lo=lo,hi=hi,vx=vx,vy=vy); a=run()
    mv=np.linalg.norm(a-base,axis=1)>0.05
    print(lo,hi,vx,vy,'moved',mv.mean().round(4),'end',a[mv].mean(0).round(2),'r',np.linalg.norm(a[mv],axis=1).mean().round(2),'base r',np.linalg.norm(base[mv],axis=1).mean().round(2))
